notes.text: Finding 8 says Compass can write a .canvas proposal and read the human's rearrangement back (medium, not run). [[research/human-surface/RESEARCH-working-in-compass-is-visual]] finding 59 found no CLI code that reads .canvas files (vaultlib globs *.md only, compass move never rewrites them) and no documentation of whether a regenerated canvas keeps the human's arrangement. Treat the read-back claim as untested.
